span.p: START: Sample Initialized (RuntimeQuestion, BudgetState, Empty EvidenceMemory)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: PLANNING Step: PLAN_QUESTION_ONLY Planner predicts MaterialObligation[]; AuthorityBindings frozen

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION Step: INITIAL_RETRIEVAL Policy proposes RETRIEVE -> PolicyGuard checks -> MedCPT retrieves E0 (initial_used = 1)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: PRE_VERIFICATION Step: OBLIGATION_VERIFICATION / GENERIC_SUFFICIENCY Evaluates E0; deterministic reducer computes readiness

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Initial PRE Sufficient? (All planned obligations READY)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: PRE_VERIFICATION Step: CORRECTIVE_RETRIEVAL Policy proposes RETRIEVE -> PolicyGuard checks corrective_used < 1 -> Retrieves E1 & merges E0 + E1 (corrective_used = 1)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: PRE_VERIFICATION Step: OBLIGATION_VERIFICATION / GENERIC_SUFFICIENCY [AFTER_CORRECTION] Re-verifies merged E0 + E1

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: GENERATION Step: GENERATE Policy proposes GENERATE -> PolicyGuard checks pre_ready & provenance -> Candidate AnswerObservation

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: GENERATION Step: DECOMPOSE Decomposes candidate answer into closed typed AtomicClaim[]

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: POST_VERIFICATION Step: ATOMIC_VERIFICATION Staged POST v4 (pair -> diagnosis -> remedies) + canonical validator

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Step: REVISION_CYCLE Condition status == NEEDS_REVISION & revision_possible & revision_used < 1?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Phase: GENERATION (Revision Sub-Cycle) Step: REVISE Policy proposes REVISE -> PolicyGuard checks -> Reviser uses existing E0/E1 only (revision_used = 1); clears old claims/POST

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Step: POST_EVIDENCE_GATE All claims SUPPORTED, all obligations ADDRESSED, zero hard failures?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Step: EMIT_ANSWER DecisionPolicy proposes ACCEPT -> PolicyGuard revalidates hard acceptance guard -> ActionExecutor emits answer

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(76, 5, 25) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: TERMINAL: TECHNICAL FAILURE (FAILED_CONTRACT | FAILED_PROVIDER | FAILED_RETRIEVAL | FAILED_QUERY_*)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Scientific Execution Bounds (Upper Bounds, Not Mandatory Steps) - Initial retrieval <= 1 - Corrective retrieval <= 1 - Grounded revision <= 1 - Physical model calls <= 34 per arm (+1 shared Planner) - PolicyGuard rejection -> FAILED_CONTRACT (never counted as ABSTAIN)
